title: he, she, it + -s
rule: In the present simple, add -s or -es after he, she and it. I, you, we and they have no -s.
ruleRu: В present simple после he, she, it у глагола есть -s или -es. После I, you, we, they окончания нет.
exampleOk: She works in a bank. They work at home.
exampleBad: She work in a bank. They works at home.
l1Trap: -s либо забывают после she, либо ставят всем лицам.

title: do and does in questions
rule: Present simple questions need do or does before the subject, and the main verb stays in the base form. Does she like tea?
ruleRu: В вопросе present simple перед подлежащим стоит do или does, а смысловой глагол без -s.
exampleOk: Does he live here?
exampleBad: Does he lives here?
l1Trap: Окончание -s оставляют и на глаголе после does.

title: don't and doesn't
rule: Negatives use don't or doesn't plus the base verb. He doesn't like it. Not He don't like and not He doesn't likes.
ruleRu: Отрицание — don't или doesn't и глагол без окончания. He doesn't like it.
exampleOk: She doesn't eat meat.
exampleBad: She don't eats meat.
l1Trap: Don't ставят на все лица, и ещё оставляют -s на глаголе.

title: always, usually, never
rule: Always, usually, often, sometimes and never go before the main verb, but after am, is, are.
ruleRu: Always, usually, often, never стоят перед обычным глаголом, но после am, is, are.
exampleOk: I often forget my keys. He is never late.
exampleBad: I forget often my keys. He never is late.
l1Trap: Наречие ставят в конец, как в русском, или перед am/is/are.

title: present continuous
rule: For an action happening now, use am, is or are plus verb-ing. I am reading. Not I reading.
ruleRu: Действие прямо сейчас — am, is или are и глагол с -ing. Не I reading.
exampleOk: She is cooking at the moment.
exampleBad: She cooking at the moment.
l1Trap: Связку am/is/are выбрасывают, потому что в русском время видно по глаголу.

title: spelling of -ing
rule: Drop a silent e before -ing: make, making. Double a final consonant after a short stressed vowel: run, running.
ruleRu: Немое e убирается: make — making. После краткого ударного гласного согласная удваивается: run — running.
exampleOk: She is sitting and writing.
exampleBad: She is siting and writeing.
l1Trap: E оставляют (writeing) или не удваивают согласную (siting).

title: verbs rarely used in -ing
rule: Verbs of state are normally not continuous: know, want, need, like, understand, mean, own. I know her. Not I am knowing her.
ruleRu: Глаголы состояния обычно не ставят в continuous: know, want, need, like, understand.
exampleOk: I understand the question.
exampleBad: I am understanding the question.
l1Trap: Раз действие сейчас, ко всем глаголам лепят -ing, включая know и want.

title: simple or continuous
rule: Present simple is for habits and facts. Present continuous is for a temporary action around now.
ruleRu: Present simple — привычка и факт. Present continuous — временное действие сейчас.
exampleOk: I usually walk, but today I am taking the bus.
exampleBad: I am usually walking, but today I take the bus.
l1Trap: Оба времени переводятся одним русским настоящим, и их не различают.

title: have and have got
rule: Have and have got both mean possession. Do you have a car? or Have you got a car? Not Do you have got.
ruleRu: Have и have got оба значат «иметь». Вопрос: Do you have? или Have you got? Не Do you have got.
exampleOk: Have you got a minute?
exampleBad: Do you have got a minute?
l1Trap: Do и got ставят вместе: Do you have got.

title: like doing
rule: After like, love, enjoy and hate, use verb-ing for the activity in general. I like swimming. Not I like swim.
ruleRu: После like, love, enjoy, hate занятие в общем — глагол с -ing. I like swimming.
exampleOk: I like reading before bed.
exampleBad: I like read before bed.
l1Trap: После like ставят голый глагол, как после want забывают to.

title: past simple, regular verbs
rule: For a finished action in the past, add -ed to a regular verb. The ending is the same for all persons. I watched a film yesterday.
ruleRu: Законченное действие в прошлом у правильного глагола — -ed. Окончание одно для всех лиц.
exampleOk: We visited our grandparents last Sunday.
exampleBad: We visit our grandparents last Sunday.
l1Trap: Прошедшее время показывают словом yesterday, а глагол оставляют в настоящем.

title: irregular past
rule: Many common verbs do not take -ed. Learn the past form: go/went, see/saw, eat/ate, buy/bought, come/came, take/took.
ruleRu: Частые глаголы не принимают -ed. Форму надо помнить: go — went, see — saw, eat — ate, buy — bought.
exampleOk: I went to the shop and bought milk.
exampleBad: I goed to the shop and buyed milk.
l1Trap: Ко всем глаголам прибавляют -ed: goed, eated, buyed.

title: did in questions and negatives
rule: Questions and negatives in the past simple use did plus the base verb, not the past form. Did you go? I didn't see it.
ruleRu: Вопрос и отрицание в past simple — did и глагол без прошедшей формы. Did you go? Не Did you went.
exampleOk: Where did you go yesterday?
exampleBad: Where did you went yesterday?
l1Trap: Прошедшую форму оставляют и после did, потому что в русском прошедшее никуда не девается.

title: was and were
rule: Was is for I, he, she, it. Were is for you, we, they. Not They was.
ruleRu: Was — с I, he, she, it. Were — с you, we, they. They were, не they was.
exampleOk: We were at home, but she was out.
exampleBad: We was at home, but she were out.
l1Trap: Was используют для всех лиц, как одну форму «был».

title: ago
rule: Ago comes after a period of time and needs the past simple: three years ago. Not before three years and not ago three years.
ruleRu: Ago стоит после промежутка времени и требует past simple: three years ago. Не before three years.
exampleOk: I started this job two years ago.
exampleBad: I started this job before two years.
l1Trap: «Назад» переводят как before, и ago ставят не туда.

title: past continuous
rule: Was or were plus verb-ing is an action in progress in the past. A shorter action that interrupts it is past simple.
ruleRu: Was или were и -ing — действие тянулось. Короткая помеха — past simple.
exampleOk: I was having a shower when the phone rang.
exampleBad: I had a shower when the phone was ringing.
l1Trap: Оба глагола ставят в одно время, и не видно, какое действие было длинным.

title: when and while
rule: While introduces the longer background action. When introduces the shorter event.
ruleRu: While — длинный фон. When — короткое событие.
exampleOk: While we were walking, it started to rain.
exampleBad: While we walked, it was starting to rain.
l1Trap: When и while оба переводятся «когда», и времена при них путают.

title: used to
titleRu: Used to — раньше, а теперь нет
rule: Used to plus the base verb is a past habit that is finished. Negative: didn't use to, without the d.
ruleRu: Used to и глагол — привычка в прошлом, которой больше нет. В отрицании d пропадает: didn't use to.
exampleOk: I used to smoke, but I stopped.
exampleBad: I was used to smoke, but I use to not.
l1Trap: Used to смешивают с be used to и оставляют -d после didn't.

title: Present Perfect form
rule: Present perfect is have or has plus the past participle, not the past simple. I have seen it. Not I have saw.
ruleRu: Present perfect — have или has и третья форма, не форма past simple. I have seen, не I have saw.
exampleOk: He has written three emails today.
exampleBad: He has wrote three emails today.
l1Trap: После have ставят обычное прошедшее: have went, has did.

title: Present Perfect or Past Simple
rule: If the time is finished and named, use past simple. If the time is not named, or the result is still true, use present perfect.
ruleRu: Если время названо и уже кончилось — past simple. Если время не названо или результат ещё важен — present perfect.
exampleOk: I have lost my keys. I lost them yesterday.
exampleBad: I have lost my keys yesterday.
l1Trap: Русское прошедшее покрывает оба случая, поэтому yesterday ставят рядом с have.

title: ever and never
rule: Ever and never usually go with the present perfect for life experience. Never already means not, so do not add don't.
ruleRu: Ever и never с present perfect — опыт жизни. Never уже значит «нет», второе отрицание не нужно.
exampleOk: I have never tried sushi.
exampleBad: I didn't never tried sushi.
l1Trap: К never добавляют don't, и время оставляют past simple.

title: yet, already, just
rule: With the present perfect, just means a moment ago, already means sooner than expected, yet means until now in questions and negatives.
ruleRu: С present perfect: just — только что, already — уже, yet — ещё в вопросах и отрицаниях, обычно в конце.
exampleOk: I have just eaten. Have you finished yet?
exampleBad: I have eaten just. Did you finish yet?
l1Trap: Yet, already и just ставят куда попало и с past simple.

title: for and since
rule: For plus a length of time, since plus a starting point. Both go with a perfect tense when the situation continues.
ruleRu: For — длительность, since — точка старта. Если это продолжается, время — perfect.
exampleOk: She has worked here since March.
exampleBad: She works here since March.
l1Trap: Since переводят как «с» и оставляют настоящее время.

title: been and gone
rule: Has gone means the person is still away. Has been means they went and came back.
ruleRu: Has gone — человек ещё там. Has been — съездил и вернулся, это опыт.
exampleOk: Dad has gone to work. He has been to Japan twice.
exampleBad: Dad has been to work, so the office is empty now.
l1Trap: Been и gone оба кажутся «был», и has gone говорят про уже законченную поездку.

title: Present Perfect Continuous
rule: Have been or has been plus verb-ing is an activity that started in the past and is still continuing, or has just stopped with a visible result.
ruleRu: Have been или has been и -ing — действие началось раньше и ещё тянется, или только что кончилось и виден результат.
exampleOk: I have been learning English for two years.
exampleBad: I am learning English since two years.
l1Trap: Долгое действие передают через настоящее или через have been без -ing.

title: How long
rule: How long asks about a duration. If the situation continues up to now, answer with the present perfect and for or since.
ruleRu: How long спрашивает о длительности. Если это длится до сих пор, ответ в present perfect с for или since.
exampleOk: How long have you known her? Since school.
exampleBad: How long do you know her? From school.
l1Trap: На how long отвечают настоящим временем и предлогом from.

title: Past Perfect
rule: Had plus the past participle shows an action that happened before another past action.
ruleRu: Had и третья форма — действие раньше другого прошлого.
exampleOk: She had left before I called.
exampleBad: She left before I had called.
l1Trap: Оба действия ставят в past simple, и порядок событий пропадает.

title: today, this week
titleRu: Today и this week с Present Perfect
rule: Today, this week and this year are unfinished. Use the present perfect for actions inside them that still connect to now.
ruleRu: Today, this week, this year ещё не кончились. Действие внутри такого периода — present perfect.
exampleOk: I have drunk four coffees today.
exampleBad: I drank four coffees today.
l1Trap: Today кажется уже прошлым, и ставят past simple, хотя день ещё идёт.
